extraHairSource.scope: Five new hairstyle sources added to the one-identity editor demo. Buzz cut and all editor hairstyle choices have no race/ancestry gate. This does not validate appearance on other head bases.
extraHairSource.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Extend this exact single-person illustrated portrait with five hairstyles for an actual editable-face demo. This is the SAME adult fictional man throughout. Copy the attached face, ears, eyebrows, eyes, nose, mouth, clean-shaven jaw, neck, purple/cream jersey, taupe background, scale, frontal pose and lighting. Change ONLY HAIR. No change to identity, age, facial expression, skin tone or facial proportions.
Output EXACTLY SIX equally sized SQUARE complete portrait cells, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, ideally 1536x1024 total. Each cell uses identical registration, head/face scale and crop. No gutters, divider lines, labels, words or numbers. Every cell is a full opaque portrait with the same taupe background, not isolated cutout hair.
TOP LEFT: original swept side-part hairstyle, faithful copy of the input. This is the registration reference.
TOP MIDDLE: BUZZ CUT. Very short uniformly cropped dark stubble, about a number 1 or 2 guard, visibly showing the shape of the scalp and clean natural hairline. It must clearly look different from the crew cut.
TOP RIGHT: WOLF CUT. A recognizable shaggy layered wolf haircut: choppy textured crown, broken airy fringe ending above the eyebrows, longer wispy sides and nape reaching the lower ears / upper neck, feathered outward ends. Dark hair, natural wearable style, not a mullet with shaved sides, not merely the same short crop. Keep eyes and eyebrows unobstructed and ears visible enough for alignment.
BOTTOM LEFT: CREW CUT. Short upright textured top, about 2–3 cm, tidy tapered shorter sides, no long fringe, not a buzz cut, not a tall quiff. Natural dark hair.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: MIDDLE PART. Soft straight-to-wavy curtain hairstyle with a clear center part, paired curved curtains framing the temples, medium length toward the ears. Leave eyebrows and eyes visible.
BOTTOM RIGHT: K-POP-INSPIRED TWO-BLOCK. A distinct contemporary Korean-pop-inspired haircut: rounded softly voluminous crown, tidy shorter sides, airy curved comma-shaped fringe swept asymmetrically to one side, subtle layered waves. Not the center-part curtains from the previous cell. Keep fringe above eyebrows, no celebrity likeness.
CRITICAL: The five edited portraits differ ONLY in their hair. Keep every face, ear, eyebrow, nose, mouth and jersey in exactly the same location as the original. Preserve the refined warm inked/cel-shaded illustration style, detailed hair strokes and broad natural skin shading of the input. No photo realism, no plastic 3D rendering, no scary generic avatar, no additional people, no jewelry or glasses, no beard. All hair must fit fully in its cell, including the wolf cut's longer nape.

editableSource.method: Matched whole-head feature sources, spatially limited feathered compositing, then bounded local proportion/expression deformation. This demonstrates one identity; no full option catalogue or ancestry generator is integrated.
editableSource.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Build a CONSISTENT SINGLE-PERSON EDITOR TEST from the attached head-and-shoulders illustration. This is NOT a new character design. Match this EXACT illustrated person, pose, proportions, palette, taupe background, jersey, camera crop and hand-inked / cel-shaded style.
Output one 1536-by-1200 image containing exactly THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equally sized complete portraits (six 512-by-600 portrait cells), edge-to-edge, no frames, no gutters, no labels, no text. Each cell is a complete finished illustration, not transparent parts. The head scale and pixel registration MUST be identical in all six cells: same chin, ears, cheekbones, mouth, nose, eye centers, jersey edges, neck and background. Treat the unchanged areas as the same duplicated master drawing.
Cell 1 TOP LEFT: the original reference portrait, copied as faithfully as possible, clean-shaven, dark swept side-part hair, original eyes, nose and brows.
Cell 2 TOP MIDDLE: SAME person and exact same master drawing. Change ONLY the eye shapes to a modestly more open, rounded eyelid shape, keeping the eye centers, iris color, overall eye spacing and eyebrows fixed. Calm natural gaze, not surprised, no large anime eyes. Everything outside the eyes is identical to Cell 1.
Cell 3 TOP RIGHT: SAME person and master drawing. Change ONLY the nose tip and nostril width to a slightly broader, softly rounded version, preserving the nose center, bridge length and lighting. No extreme nose, no distortion. Everything outside the nose is identical to Cell 1.
Cell 4 BOTTOM LEFT: SAME person and master drawing. Change ONLY hairstyle to a short textured dark crop with naturally wavy texture and tidy sides. Keep skull scale, forehead, hairline placement, ears, face, eye/nose/mouth locations, jersey and background identical. The side part from Cell 1 is completely replaced.
Cell 5 BOTTOM MIDDLE: SAME person and master drawing. Add ONLY a neat short dark beard and mustache following the original jaw and chin. Original lips still clearly visible. Do not enlarge the jaw or change mouth, nose, eyes, hair or skin palette.
Cell 6 BOTTOM RIGHT: SAME person and master drawing. Change ONLY eyebrows to slightly thicker, straighter natural eyebrows at the same brow locations. Keep eye shapes and everything else identical.
CRITICAL: Every cell is the SAME FACE and same person, NOT six related people. No face drift, no skin-tone drift, no change in head height/width, no changes to lighting. Existing shadows around a changed feature must remain coherent and preserve the original warm skin palette. Maintain the reference's elegant drawing quality and natural proportions. No photorealistic rendering, no rough vector simplification, no glossy 3D head, no generic cartoon avatar. The cells will be used as matched feature sources in an actual local interactive demo, so consistency and registration matter more than dramatic variations.
